Man Falls From Roof While Reaching for Ice Cream in Sonbhadra

A man in Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh, fell from the first floor of a house while attempting to retrieve ice cream. The incident, captured on CCTV, shows the individual losing balance from the veranda. Onlookers immediately came to his aid after the fall. Fortunately, reports indicate the man did not sustain serious injuries.
